## Correctly documenting reportable workplace accidents

By Bob Laychuck | CSHSE & Pregnancy Safety Officer | Faculty of Medicine & Dentistry

Workplace incidents are reportable when they may cause death or serious harm to health, or where property affects health and safety. The requirements for accident reporting are listed in the OH&SA. Amherstburg Memorial’s (AMHS) Workplace Safety & Health Program is aligned with the OH&SA requirements, as AMHS is committed to promoting health and safety and preventing injuries among its employees and patients.
